explication: actionlint is a static checker for GitHub Actions workflows. Users provide workflow YAML through the CLI or browser playground; the entry point invokes the linter, which parses YAML into a workflow AST, runs validation passes and specialized expression analysis, then emits diagnostics. Major branches cover syntax, actions and reusable workflows, security, dependency/glob/runner checks, and optional shellcheck/pyflakes integrations. The exact wiring of unsampled rule implementations is inferred only where documented by the README and visible API names.
